pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with relatively sharp, linear edges and distinct vertices. The patches on the flank are larger and more structured as 4-to-6 sided polygons, while those on the lower extremities appear smaller and more fragmented.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, cream-colored interstitial lattice forming a complete topological graph. Junction nodes are clearly defined, primarily as tri-coordinate intersections. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains relatively consistent across the lateral flank surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible bristled mane along the upper neck and shoulder ridge, exhibiting a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D contour against the background.
